what: Kinetic quote: words cascade in while cycling type faces; the keyword lands last, twice the size, on its own hit
title: The eye only sees what the mind is *ready* for
intent: Make one sentence land, with the keyword as the payoff
action: Words cascade in letter by letter, cycling faces at 12 fps before they settle; a short vacuum; the keyword lands on its own line, about twice the size, in the accent, with a print kick and outline echoes; a giant outline marquee slides behind; lines leave one by one
make_it_yours: Mark the keyword with asterisks in the title: `--title "the mind is *ready* for"`. `|` forces a line break. Change `FACES` to the faces you have (the last one is where words settle) and `KEY_SCALE` for the keyword's size.
craft_note: The keyword is the hero: its own line, about twice the size, its own hit. The words before it are spread so it lands after a short vacuum (`VACUUM`). Long sentences get a longer `--duration` or a later `keyword lands` hit.
look: Typographic poster: warm paper, black ink, one ultramarine word (style atlas #9)
